squirrelscan-skills-accessibility-audit.description: Audit a site with squirrelscan's accessibility audit rules via the squirrel CLI or hosted squirrelscan MCP server in Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Codex, Cursor, and other coding agents, checking accessible names, labels, ARIA, headings, landmarks, contrast, language, zoom, and target sizes. It supports an optional WCAG level filter and checklist, fixes issues by component and template, and says plainly that automated checks cover only part of WCAG and what a person must still check. Use when asked "check my site's accessibility" or "run a WCAG audit".
squirrelscan-skills-accessibility-audit.author: squirrelscan

squirrelscan-skills-agent-experience-aud.description: Evaluate your site's agent experience with squirrelscan audit rules via the squirrel CLI or hosted squirrelscan MCP server in Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Codex, Cursor, and other coding agents, checking robots.txt bot access, content present without JavaScript, llms.txt, AGENTS.md, markdown responses, API discovery, and machine-readable policies. Use to discover and assess website or webapp issues and drive them to fixed.
squirrelscan-skills-audit-website.author: squirrelscan

squirrelscan-skills-broken-link-checker.description: Find broken internal and external links, broken anchors, redirect chains, orphan pages, broken images, and dead sitemap URLs with squirrelscan audit rules via the squirrel CLI or hosted squirrelscan MCP server in Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Codex, Cursor, and other coding agents. squirrelscan-skills-launch-checklist.author: squirrelscan

squirrelscan-skills-performance-audit.author: squirrelscan
